Vietnamese restaurant first choice
Sep 2026 • Friends
The best dining experience in Vietnam, better than the two Michelin restaurants I've had in Hanoi, and the price was very nice 👍, around 60 yuan per person.
Food/Taste: The dishes are very unique, featuring many local specialties of Shunhua, and the taste is great. Chinese palates can be quite picky, but this experience was surprisingly wonderful.
Service: best! The service is very good. Both the girl at the front desk and the girl who taught us about the food were very attentive and patient, and they were smiling and cute, which was very healing for our tiring trip. (The front desk is Tháo)
Environment: best! The chopsticks have paper sleeves, the dining table has wet wipes, the bathroom has ice cubes, and it is odorless with a special scent of lemongrass.
Suggestion: Perhaps consider operating a Chinese app? There are quite a few Chinese tourists here.

Supplement: I found this store on Chinese apps (Xiaohongshu and Dianping).
